_doc: V6 snapping and crush & flatten (src/snap.h). radius: placing / moving this close to a free compatible socket snaps onto it (m). joinTol: sockets this close and facing each other are joined (m); a snapped piece's own ground may differ from the chain's base height by up to the asset's maxGrade. compatible: socket kinds that join each other besides equal kinds. assets: sockets for assets whose generator is not re-run (asset space p, outward dir x/z). crush: placing or moving a building removes vegetation / nature instances under its footprint (+ margin) up to maxHeight m and flattens the ground to its base with a feathered skirt (m); taller growth blocks the placement. categories: asset categories that count as buildings (enterable assets with wall bays count too).
